• Raipur-Visakhapatnam Expressway!* Bridging East India
Embark on a journey exploring the *Raipur-Visakhapatnam Expressway*, a monumental 464-kilometer, six-lane highway currently under construction in India!
This video dives into:
Connecting the Dots: Witness how this expressway will bridge the gap between Chhattisgarh, Odisha, & Andhra Pradesh, boosting regional trade & tourism.
Faster & Smoother Journeys: Uncover the potential for significantly reduced travel times between major cities like Raipur, Visakhapatnam, & more.
